test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL 2022 - General Awareness(Held On: 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: In March 2022, the “Stree Manoraksha project” was launched by which of the following Union Minister?

options.text: Union Minister for Women and Child Development
Union Minister for Law and Justice
Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Minister for Women and Child Development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ‘**STREE MANORAKSHA’**– an initiative aimed at “Integrating Training and Supervision in Psychosocial and **Mental Health Care for One Stop Centre (OSC) staffs to support Women Facing Violence**” is a project started in The National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (**NIMHANS**)
 
• The project is headed by Dr. Prabha S. Chandra, Professor of Psychiatry and Associate Dean, of NIMHANS.
 
• Stree Manoraksha project” was launched by the **Union Minister for Women and Child Development, Smt. Smriti Zubin Irani** on the occasion of International Women's Day Week.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0d58973373a1d898eebeb83afac2a813cb1058403b4bb646acaf72fd7e71e63.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Union Minister for Education -** Dharmendra Pradhan**
 
• Union Minister for Law and Justice -** Kiren Rijiju**
 
• Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare - **Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya**
